source: Branch2025 plugin 1.1.4.4 (c0f45f41) Solve on data/rooftop_demo.dwg-equivalent drawing (licensed AutoCAD 2025, 2026-09-22): the four groups the plugin SPLITS before calling the stringer. group_grid is the exact overlay of the plugin's own piece requests (pieces keep the full grid and blank other panels); pieces are the plugin's requests in emission order; responses are the service's recorded answers; plugin_strings are the committed, reopened strings of the group.
